_provenance.source: agy 1.5.16 (linux-x64, the release the vendor's update manifest served that day), installed into an isolated prefix and run in a bwrap sandbox whose OS home was a tmpfs, with a scratch HOME and no sign-in. Each Drive-shaped run used the adapter's own argv (`--output-format=stream-json --input-format=stream-json`, stdin closed) plus the mode under test; agy then stopped at its sign-in prompt.
_provenance.note: Each string is ONE line copied verbatim from the run's stdout, stderr or agy's own run log (`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/log/cli-<stamp>.log` in the scratch home). Only lines that carry no path, account, token or prompt were taken, so none needed sanitizing. The sign-in URL agy printed on every run is not kept. `--mode auto` was refused here because the run was not signed in (agy's log: `rollout flag off`); whether a signed-in personal account gets Auto in this sandbox is a separate capture.
